graph.notFound: No result set is available, or the entity/fact is not in this result set. Run extraction or select another result set.
graph.requestFailed: Loading failed. Please retry. Error code: {code}
graph.searchHint: Search by name, entity IRI, type or source row key
graph.subject: Subject
graph.derivedHint: Derived edges accelerate queries and do not count as facts. Inspect the associated entity for provenance.
graph.quarantineWarning: This source row has quarantine records. Do not assume the entire row entered the candidate graph; inspect the affected fields.
graph.noEvidence: No source evidence is available. A complete provenance chain has not been established.
graph.traceHint: Enter an entity IRI or a complete subject, predicate and object to trace evidence in the selected result set.
graph.canvasHint: Select a node to explore its neighborhood. Tab and Enter also work. The tables below retain every fact and its evidence link.
graph.visibleCounts: {nodes} visible nodes / {total} total entities · {edges} visible edges
graph.truncated: This view is truncated to at most 200 nodes and 1,000 edges. It is not the complete graph. Select a center or hide types to narrow the view.
graph.graphQuarantine: Run #{run} has {count} quarantine issues. Affected source records or fields may be absent from this candidate graph. Inspect the run before assuming provenance is complete.
graph.noVisibleNodes: No nodes match this view. Clear the center or adjust hidden types.

dashboard.unpublishedHint: Draft resources are unpublished and cannot be assembled or extracted
dashboard.quarantineHint: Quarantine records indicate problem rows during extraction; inspect fields and transform chains
dashboard.noCurrentGraph: No extraction run yet; no current result set

report.title: Instance Validation Report
report.chooseGraph: Select a graph revision to run validation

rules.intro: Manage standards-based and enterprise rules, save expressions, and check positive and negative examples.
rules.identifierTaken: This rule identifier is already in use. Choose another identifier.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Create a rule and record its source.
rules.editingRevision: Editing rule revision {revision}. Saving checks for concurrent changes.
rules.sourceHint: For standards, record the standard and clause identifiers with your own description. For enterprise rules, identify the internal source.
rules.shaclHint: Automatic checks support SHACL Core. Use Turtle expressions and examples with the declared target class IRI.
rules.notRunHint: No executor is connected for this mode. The result is Not run, which does not mean Pass.
rules.examplesHint: The positive example must conform and the negative example must violate the rule. Both must contain instances of the target class. These checks validate the examples, not overall standards conformance.
rules.saveBeforeTest: Save all changes before checking the current revision.
rules.staleTest: The expression or examples have changed. The report below belongs to the previously saved revision.
rules.examplesFailed: The actual example results differ from the expectations. Review the rule and examples.
rules.conflict: This rule has changed. Close and reopen the editor. Your changes have not overwritten the server copy.
rules.notFound: This rule does not exist or has been deleted. Refresh the list.
rules.invalid: The rule could not be processed. Check the expression and examples. Reason: {reason}
rules.requestFailed: Request failed. Please retry. Error code: {code}

export.title: Ontology export
export.intro: Download a published ontology as Turtle or JSON-LD with pinned resource versions and bilingual labels.
export.selectOntology: Select an ontology with a published version
export.snapshotHint: Exports use resource snapshots frozen at publication. Draft changes are excluded. Older snapshots without semantic structure are rejected with a reason.
export.downloaded: The file has been generated and the download has started.
export.failed: Export failed. Check the selected revision for completeness. Reason: {reason}

templates.title: Assembly templates
templates.intro: Manage templates with clear provenance and explicitly pinned published resource revisions.
templates.builtinHint: Built-in templates are read-only. Copy the template before making changes.
templates.pinHint: Resource revisions are explicitly pinned. Template changes do not alter existing ontologies. Incompatible revisions require explicit resolution.
templates.inUse: This template is still referenced by an ontology and cannot be deleted.
templates.conflict: The template has changed. Close and reopen it before editing.
templates.failed: Operation failed. Check the inputs and resource revisions. Reason: {reason}
templates.createdOntology: Draft ontology {name} was created from template {template}.
